div.head: VI Atr 41
div.ab: K. Nu wille we [eac] læran Godes þeowas georne, þæt hy huru hy sylfe wærlice beþencan ⁊ þurh Godes fultum clænnesse lufian ⁊ georne heora bocum ⁊ gebedum fylgean ⁊ dæges ⁊ nihtes oft ⁊ gelome clypian to Christe ⁊ for eal Christen folc þingian georne.

Nu wille we eac læran Godes þeowas georne, þæt hy huru hy sylfe wærlice beþencan ⁊ þurh Godes fultum clænnesse lufian ⁊ georne heora bocum ⁊ gebedum fylgean ⁊ dæges ⁊ nihtes oft ⁊ gelome clypian to Christe ⁊ for eal Christen folc þingian georne.

Nu wille we eac læran Godes þeowas georne þæt hy huru hy sylfe wærlice beþencan and þurh Godes fultum clænnesse lufian, and georne heora bocum and gebedum fylgean, and dæges and nihtes oft and gelome clypian to Christe and for eal Christen folc þingian georne.

App. 41. Nun wollen wir auch die Gottesdiener ernstlich anweisen, dass sie wenigstens auf sich selbst sorgsam achten und mit Gottes Hilfe Keuschheit pflegen und eifrig ihren [Kanon-]Büchern und Gebeten Folge leisten und bei Tage und Nacht oft und eifrig Christus anrufen und eifrig Fürbitte thun für alles Christenvolk.

Appendix. 41. Now we will also earnestly instruct the servants of God that they at least take careful heed of themselves and with God's help cherish chastity, and eagerly follow their [canonical] books and prayers, and by day and night often and eagerly call upon Christ, and pray eagerly for all Christian people.

Now we desire likewise earnestly to enjoin upon the servants of God, that above all they carefully take thought for themselves, and by God’s help practise celibacy, and diligently apply themselves to their books and prayers, and day and night frequently and often call upon Christ, and zealously intercede for all Christian people.

Now we likewise wish to earnestly instruct God’s servants to give thought to themselves with special care and with God’s help embrace celibacy, and attend diligently to their books and prayers, and call upon Christ often and frequently both day and night, and zealously intercede for all Christian people.
